title: Vishing-Tactics-Bench: Forecasting Exploitation Trajectories in Voice Phishing Calls
abstract: arXiv:2609.07151v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Voice phishing (vishing) unfolds in real time; by the time a call has ended and post-hoc classification is possible, the harm has already been done. The more actionable question is which concrete harm (Information Gathering or Financial Exploitation) an ongoing call is tactically progressing toward. We present Vishing-Tactics-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness (SA) framework that recasts vishing defense from after-the-fact fraud classification to harm projection: predicting at each turn whether the call will reach either terminal harm. We adapt MITRE ATT&CK to vishing as a 6-tactic taxonomy (Vishing-Tactics) and label 35,340 scammer utterances across 5,645 synthetic Chinese calls. We define Exploitation Trajectory Forecasting, a survival-style protocol over the two terminal harms with three metrics: AP@k, C-index, and divergence error. translated_title: Vishing-Tactics-Bench：语音钓鱼通话中利用轨迹的预测
translated_abstract: 语音钓鱼以实时方式展开；当通话结束、事后分类成为可能时，危害已经造成。更具可操作性的问题是：正在进行的通话在战术上正朝着哪种具体危害（信息收集或金融剥削）发展。我们提出了 Vishing-Tactics-Bench，这是一个基于 Endsley 态势感知框架的基准，将语音钓鱼防御从事后欺诈分类重新构建为危害预测：在每一轮对话中预测通话是否将到达两种终端危害之一。我们将 MITRE ATT&CK 框架适配到语音钓鱼场景，形成包含 6 种战术的分类体系，并对 5,645 通合成中文通话中的 35,340 条诈骗者话语进行了标注。我们定义了利用轨迹预测任务，这是一种针对两种终端危害的生存分析式评估协议，包含三个指标：AP@k、C-index 和散度误差。从马尔可夫启发式方法到微调大语言模型的各种基线实验表明……
tldr: 提出基于 Endsley 态势感知框架的语音钓鱼防御基准 Vishing-Tactics-Bench，将防御范式从事后欺诈分类转变为对正在进行的通话是否将到达信息收集或金融剥削等终端危害的实时预测，并构建了 6 战术分类体系和 35,340 条标注话语的数据集。
en_tdlr: Vishing-Tactics-Bench is a benchmark grounded in Endsley's situation-awareness framework that recasts vishing defense from post-hoc fraud classification to real-time forecasting of whether an ongoing call will reach terminal harms, featuring a 6-tactic taxonomy adapted from MITRE ATT&CK and 35,340 labeled scammer utterances.
